text:
Dylan Holloway is one of the fastest skaters in the league (94th percentile in top speed) and one of the better shooters (84th percentile for his hardest shots), and he's been playing like it without the goals to show. Six goals on 8.4 expected in 24 games, with 56 shots and 52 hits, for a Blues team that has won six of his last seven.

The flag on him is "due". He's shooting 10.7% against a likely range of 11 to 15%, and St. Louis has scored 5.3 fewer goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice. At 5v5 the Blues take 53% of the expected goals with him out there, almost five points better than without him. The two-goal night in Pittsburgh last Thursday (one into an empty net) was a reminder of what the finishing looks like when it comes.

Evolving-Hockey had him 20th among 401 forwards in wins above replacement last season, while warning his results ran ahead of his chances. This season it's the reverse. His minutes have slipped to under 16 in three of his last four, which is the one thing worth watching.
